mechanism: Both drugs increase serotonergic activity and sympathomimetic effects; lisdexamfetamine is a prodrug of amphetamine which can potentiate serotonergic effects and increase cardiovascular stimulation when combined with SSRIs.
action: Monitor for serotonin syndrome symptoms (agitation, tremor, hyperthermia, hyperreflexia) and cardiovascular effects (tachycardia, hypertension); use combination cautiously with dose optimization and patient education.
